# Main taxes in New Caledonia 



## **Principal taxes due by Companies (general law):** 

- Company Income Tax ( _IS): 30%_ 

- Additional solidarity contribution ( _Contribution sociale additionnelle - CSA_ ): from 5% to 15% applicable to companies subject to the 30% tax rate, for profits in excess of XPF 200 M 

- Withholding tax on dividends ( _Impфt sur les Revenus de Valeurs Mobiliers - IRVM_ ): distribution tax of 13.25 % 

- Business licence tax ( _Contribution а la Patente - Patente_ ) 

- Tax on services ( _Taxe de Solidaritй sur les Services - TSS_ ) : 5% on services 

- Import taxes and duties: up to 60% 







# Mining Tax Law 

## **Specificities of mining tax law:** 



- **IS tax rate** : 35% for mining and metallurgical operatives (exploration, extraction, exploitation and operation) 

- **TSS** : general law exemptions granted to the mining industry
